items.title: Democracy in Africa: Coups, crises and foregone conclusions
items.summary: As Ethiopia formally counts the votes following Monday's election, attitudes toward democracy appear to be shifting across Africa. In April, Burkina Faso's junta leader told the Burkinabe people to "forget" democracy.
